QuestInfo.name: Gift for the Chief
QuestInfo.1: Camila asked you to deliver her prettily-packaged pie to Chief Stan. Find him near the park entrance at the center of #m100000000#.
QuestInfo.2: You found Chief Stan near the park entrance at the center of #m100000000# and gave him the pie. Seems like he really likes pies.
QuestInfo.0: Camila is smiling at you, holding a Pie Box packaged all nicely. Just...standing there smiling at you.

0.0: Here! I boxed up a very special Horny Mushroom Pie! You didn't meet the chief yet, did you? Go greet him with this!

yes.0: Chief Stan is usually near the entrance to the park. He takes walks there when he's worried...I think he's worried about his son, Alex, who ran away from home. Hopefully this pie will cheer him up.

no.0: Just drop off the pie with Chief Stan. I mean, you can stick around and talk to him if you want. You've been in #m100000000# for awhile, but you still haven't really taked to him, huh? Well, this pie is a good excuse!

1.0: Hm? Who are you? You're new in #m100000000#, aren't you?\r\n#L0##bMy name is #h0# and Camila sent me to give this to you. It's a home-made Horny Mushroom Pie.#l\n#k
1.1: #h0#! Hello! Good to meet you and your pie. I heard about you from Athena Pierce. There's just been so much going on around here... Anyway, thanks for the pie.

yes.0: Horny Mushroom Pie, huh? What does this taste like...?

npc.0: Chief Stan is usually near the entrance to the park. He takes walks there when he's worried...I think he's worried about his son, Alex, who ran away from home. Hopefully this pie will cheer him up.

item.0: Who are you? I don't recall seeng you around #m100000000#...

lost.0: Hey, you didn't even take the pie! What kind of delivery person are you?
